title: tpkg package manifest v1
description: The L2 package manifest (spec 03 §6), carried as tpkg extension block type 2 (spec 02 §5b) — YAML in the container, OUTSIDE every payload image, readable without backend knowledge. It owns composition (identity, entrypoint/suite entries, package-level jail + env, per-entry runtime refs); payload manifests stay inside images and own self-description. This schema is the STRUCTURAL contract; the tpkg crate's PackageManifest::validate() is the semantic gate (unique entry names, slot-capacity bound, non-empty fields). Unknown keys are tolerated at every level for forward compatibility; only jail is guaranteed lossless (its shape is spec 08's).

entries.description: One entry per invocable command (N=1 for simple apps; N entries for suites). Entry names are unique (enforced by the crate's validate()).

jail.description: Package-level jail request. Opaque here: spec 08 owns the shape; the block is preserved verbatim.

version.description: Free-form version string (semver AND datever packages exist).

name.description: The command name (the shim registers under this).

slot.description: Which payload slot carries the entrypoint's image (0..TPKG_MAX_SLOTS-1; the bound against the concrete package's slot count happens at embed time).

entrypoint.description: Which PROVIDES entrypoint inside the slot's image.

runtime_ref.description: Per-entry runtime reference (type@version;tebako=<abi>[;params]) — kills the trailer's 128-byte single-field limit for suites and multi-runtime packages.
